summary: Fernhill Goods appeared in 68% of 240 sampled shopper-style questions and ranks 2nd of 4 tracked brands. Review sites drive most of your citations; comparison questions are where you lose ground.

steps.label: Collecting data
steps.description: Sampling 240 shopper-style questions across AI assistants.

steps.label: Analyzing answers
steps.description: Detecting brand mentions, positions and cited sources.

recommendations.title: Add structured product data to your top 20 pages
recommendations.description: Pages with complete price, availability and review markup are cited about twice as often in the sample. Start with your best sellers.

recommendations.title: Answer comparison questions directly
recommendations.description: You trail Alder & Oak on "X vs Y" questions. A short, honest comparison page per category gives assistants something quotable.

recommendations.title: Refresh buying guides older than 12 months
recommendations.description: Four guides that used to be cited are now skipped. Update specs, prices and dates, then re-publish.

recommendations.title: Earn coverage on two more review sites
recommendations.description: Review sites are your biggest citation source. Sending samples to two more outlets widens that base.

recommendations.title: Add FAQ markup to shipping and returns
recommendations.description: Assistants rarely quote your policies today. Clear FAQ blocks make them easier to reuse accurately.
